title: ECHO: Base44 and governed reader reconciliation
request: diff https://solid-echo-read-flow.base44.app/ and https://martin.govern-ai.ca/echo/, then reconcile in to github

sources.name: Base44 live app
sources.method: Direct Chrome UI and public JavaScript bundle

sources.name: Governed live app
sources.method: Direct Chrome UI and SHA-256 of all six production files

sources.name: Stable source
sources.method: Read-only archive of CT920 Git commit; original working tree untouched

features.governed: Same visual family, with a persistent transport and PHAROS link.
features.resolution: Preserve the governed design; restore a visible Drafts close button.

features.base44: Five Base44 premium voices (River, Honey, Sunny, Storm, Spark), plus a system list capped at 60 displayed entries.
features.governed: All browser voices, searchable and grouped by language; local-service voices marked on device.
features.resolution: Keep the browser catalog and explicit provider distinction. Premium Base44 voices remain a separate service.

features.base44: System speech queues one utterance per word; cloud highlighting estimates word positions from audio duration.
features.governed: One sentence at a time; sentence highlighting, click-to-seek, previous/next and follow scrolling.
features.resolution: Retain sentence tracking, compatible with spoken number substitutions.

features.base44: Cloud GenerateSpeech sends text.slice(0,5000); the visible document can exceed what is spoken.
features.governed: No 5,000-character cut; long unpunctuated sentences split into bounded utterances.
features.resolution: Retain the governed text path; 10,000-word import and segmentation verified.

features.governed: English/French amounts, dates, ranges, serials and other number forms; other languages pass through.
features.resolution: Keep the governed decipher toggle and language-aware voice suggestion.

features.base44: TXT/MD read locally; DOCX/PDF uploaded to Base44 for extraction; 10 MB input limit.
features.resolution: Keep in-browser imports. TXT, DOCX, EPUB and text PDF fixtures verified.

features.base44: No URL import control in the inspected live Base44 app.
features.governed: Same-origin Worker /echo/api/extract with redirect, literal-host and size checks.
features.resolution: Preserve first-party extraction; example.com fetched in the local Worker and UI.

features.base44: Base44 Draft entity, listing the newest 100; requires the platform backend.
features.governed: Up to 50 drafts in localStorage, searchable and reloadable in that browser.
features.resolution: Keep local drafts. Existing Base44 drafts are not copied or synchronized.

features.base44: Space/Escape shortcuts exclude standard form controls; sheet includes a close affordance.
features.governed: Adds arrow navigation, but Space on buttons hijacked their action; 320px voice menu extended to x=328.
features.resolution: Respect focused controls and dialogs; constrain menu to x=8..312 at 320px; add Close Drafts.

features.governed: Live reader is a separate Worker; stable source was absent from GitHub.
features.resolution: Import CT920 stable commit 7d5be63 into ECHOapp, replace older active stack, retain its Git history.

features.base44: Base44 premium speech is present; no dictation control observed in the current UI.
features.governed: Uncommitted CT920 cloud-voice experiment exists; no clone or dictation controls in the verified stable live build.
features.resolution: Leave unfinished work untouched. Present-release scope only; no permanent product exclusion and no provider setup.

verification.detail: All six baseline build files match the live governed site by SHA-256.
42/42 Node tests: 36 recovered segmentation/pronunciation tests and six Worker-route tests.
npm run build; production Vite assets built successfully.
TXT, DOCX, EPUB and text PDF imported and exact expected text observed after completion.
10,000-word file imported intact; existing segmentation test passes.
Local Worker and browser URL import return the public Example Domain text.
Sample saved locally and found again after reload; Close Drafts dismisses the sheet.
French text selects Amelie fr-CA; English sample selects English again.
Space on Sample keeps playback idle after fix; before fix it started playback.
Voice menu is 304px wide inside a 320px viewport. No document overflow at 390px and 1470px.
Play/pause, next sentence, resume and stop verified with controlled speech events on a 10,000-word document. Fixture removed by reload.
Native browser speech emitted five end events within about 0.22 seconds without start events in this automation session. Audible output and natural timing were not acoustically verified.
No premium synthesis request, upload, account change or spend was performed.
Source reconciliation only. Neither live app was modified.

limits: This reconciles the current reader into GitHub. It does not merge or deploy automatically.
Base44 account data, paid voices and unfinished cloud cloning were not migrated.
Browser online voices may send text to the browser voice provider. Only voices marked on device report localService=true.
Worker guard tests cover route and literal-address behavior, not a complete DNS or security audit.
The stale cached search result showed an older dictation console; direct live inspection supersedes it.
changes: Recovered the exact live stable source and build configuration.
Replaced the obsolete active UI/Worker/clone stack; earlier source and recordings remain in Git history.
Restored focused-control keyboard behavior and mobile Drafts dismissal; fixed voice menu clipping.
Added CI validation, six Worker tests and reproducible comparison evidence.
